findings.title: _run() is a ~240-line multi-phase function; the post-child comparison block is mechanically separable, though linear security-critical control flow is a defensible counter-argument
findings.reason: The ordering of the stages inside _run() -- acquire lock, snapshot protected files, launch the child, restore, then compare -- is itself the safety property this runner provides. Extracting helpers would move that ordering from a single readable sequence into call-site convention, where a later edit could reorder it without an obvious tell. The reviewer that raised it stated the same counter-argument and did not assert the finding should block. Revisit only if the function grows a second responsibility rather than more steps of the same one.
